newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar hovers in tight range, awaits NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar hovers in tight range, awaits NY.

text.p: White sugar futures stayed tightly mixed in very light trade on Thursday morning with little other than routine spread trading as a feature of the lacklustre activity.
Traders said the London market was unlikely to show much inclination to move before the New York open when selling of the May/May arbitrage was again expected at around $69 and above.
On the whites, the nearby May/August spread narrowed to around 60 cents after closing at $1.40. Trading ranges were generally tight across the board at a maximum $1.10 on the spot May contract.
At 1225 GMT May was down just 10 cents at $307.00, steering well clear of initial resistance at $310.00. August was up 30 cents at $306.00 and volume amounted to a scant 202 lots.
The Paris market followed a similar tight trading pattern with May dominating the Matif exchange's total turnover of 213 lots.
May was up 30 cents at $307.10 and August untraded.
